more_beautiful.reason: A looks finished and consistent: warm cream cards, one vermilion accent and large, well-spaced type group the information clearly. B is flatter and rougher, with single orphaned characters (字, 书) in the mobile class cards, an awkward tile/title layout, a stark black button and a sparse, lopsided desktop layout.

less_generic.reason: B's rice-grid (米字格) practice tiles showing 楷 and 行 are a real calligraphy-class motif that also helps people tell the two classes apart, while A relies on the stock 'Chinese style' kit (red seal, brush-font title, red swoosh, shadowed cards) that reads like an AI theme.
